env_context_strategy.note: The trace-analysis stage seeds initial actions. The model explores via search tools over a CodeGraph.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: we design a context manager that dynamically prunes the searched context. The pruning algorithm leverages a node distance heuristic within the graph-oriented codebase.
context_compaction.note: Distance-aware pruning of search results, keeping the top-12 (context_control=True by default in search.cfg). This does not fit a listed value exactly; it is the closest.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: We design a custom-designed LLM prompt, which will generateObservation (O),Potential Bug Locations (PB ), andSearch Actions (SA)in each step.
tool_call_format.note: The output parser (SearchOutputParser) parses the model's text. The runner uses json.loads on responses, and the exact parser file is not shown.

tool_count.note: Six search functions are returned by get_search_functions. The Edit agent's editor tool is used in the optional edit stage.

edit_primitive.note: Commands are create, str_replace and insert. They are available in the EditAgent stage, which is not the default final stage.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: from llama_index.core.tools import BaseTool, FunctionTool, ToolOutput
tool_schema_source.note: LlamaIndex FunctionTool derives schema from function signatures and docstrings. This is an inference.

protocol_standardization.note: The dependency file (pyproject.toml) was not shown, so no grep was possible.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: ORCALOCA follows a reason-and-act workflow with a constrained action space.
loop_primitives.note: The stage pipeline is trace_analysis -> search -> edit (Stage enum in agent.py). A priority queue schedules actions.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: The ASQ has priority management which is implemented on top of a heap data structure.
planning_granularity.note: The Action Scheduler Queue is a stored structure of planned actions.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: In this way, the main agent could work with the scoring sub-agent in a multi-agent workflow.
multi_agent_topology.note: The main search agent invokes a scoring sub-agent (CodeScorer). There is also a pipeline of trace-analysis, search and edit agents.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: The sub-agent (implemented by another LLM agent) will select the top-k most relevant methods

human_in_loop.note: The run loop code is truncated, so a confirmation surface cannot be ruled out.

short_term_state.note: The search agent keeps a search_queue and action_history in extra_state.

long_term_memory.note: Full config and run code are not in the bundle.

self_verification.note: verify_agent_wrapper.py exists in the file tree but its content is not shown. Agentless patch validation lives in a third-party repo.

retry_policy.note: OrcarAgent has a current_retry parameter; the retry logic in run.py is not shown.

rollback.note: Per-file history is kept in _file_history. The command is available only in the edit stage.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: The process terminates when ASQ is empty or follows the convergence condition (See Appendix E).
termination_condition.note: max_iterations=10 in SearchWorker. The queue-empty/convergence condition was mapped to model_declared as the closest value.

execution_isolation.note: The trace analysis runs in the container. The search tools read the repo on the host.

network_policy.note: The container setup code (environment/utils.py) is not shown.

tracing.note: Per-stage JSON outputs are written, plus logs.

eval_hooks.note: The runner is built in. Final grading uses the official SWE-bench scripts.
